selection.rule: For every instance frozen by R3-311, retain the depot and the eight customers with the smallest numeric node IDs. Preserve capacity, coordinates, demand, time windows, service times, and objective semantics; reduce max_vehicles to min(source max_vehicles, 8) because empty vehicles cannot improve the objective.

modeling.time_transform: ready, due, and service values multiplied exactly by 1000; transformed travel uses the conservative arc ceiling
modeling.objective_encoding: fixed_vehicle_cost * selected_route_count + transformed_integer_distance, where fixed_vehicle_cost = max_arc_cost * (customer_count + max_vehicles) + 1
modeling.proof_scope: Optimality applies only to the derived conservative integer model. Independently recomputed Euclidean-double distance is descriptive and is not an optimality proof for the source model or the 100-customer instance.

exact_reference_solver.name: Exhaustive feasible-route enumeration plus Google OR-Tools CP-SAT set partitioning
exact_reference_solver.enumeration: Depth-first enumerate every non-empty ordered customer subset that satisfies transformed capacity and time windows and can return to the depot. Each complete feasible route becomes one set-partitioning column.
exact_reference_solver.coverage_constraints: Select feasible route columns so every one of the eight customers is covered exactly once and selected route count does not exceed max_vehicles.
exact_reference_solver.ground_truth_policy: Use TRANSFORMED_MODEL_GROUND_TRUTH only when enumeration completes without hitting its ceiling, CP-SAT returns OPTIMAL, and the selected solution passes the independent R3-314 verifier. Otherwise retain the incumbent/status but do not use a ground-truth label.

comparison.candidate_acceptance: A candidate is comparable only when the independent R3-314 verifier accepts a complete solution.
comparison.different_vehicle_policy: Report the vehicle-count gap and do not collapse the hierarchical difference into a scalar distance gap.
comparison.source_double_policy: Report independently recomputed double distances descriptively; do not treat their difference as a proven source-model optimality gap.

statistical_plan.reason: This bounded cross-check audits solver correctness and objective gaps; it is not a population-level hypothesis test.

exclusions_and_stopping.instance_policy: Retain every selected derived instance and every candidate/exact outcome.
exclusions_and_stopping.campaign_stop: Stop only for invalid source identity, implementation or verifier defect, enumeration above the frozen ceiling, or uncontrolled resource growth; do not substitute instances.
